label: rem:q-bkm-criterion-interpretation
title: The $q$-BKM bound as an obstruction indicator at the substrate boundary
html: Remark (interpretation). The q-vorticity estimate translates the classical Beale--Kato--Majda criterion algebraically. The bound functions as a diagnostic limit check in the observable universe. The BKM condition shifts from a PDE survival test to an obstruction indicator at the q \to 1 substrate boundary.
